Seasonal doors

Enrolment comes in waves

The Academy opens a few times a year. Between intakes, a therapist who is ready today can only book a call and wait, and every launch starts from a cold list.

No bridge

From a reel straight to a discovery call

A practitioner has to go from watching your content to booking a call about a six-month qualification. Nothing in between lets her experience how you teach first.

Capped by hours

Growth runs through your diary

The Acne Programme, consultations and Power Hours are all 1:1. Every extra pound of revenue there needs more of your time; the Academy is the offer that scales without it.

Skin professionals already want your 360 approach. Right now most of them can only follow along for free, and the ones ready to train with you can’t be told apart from the rest.

A £17 live masterclass for skin practitioners, “The 360 Acne Masterclass”, as an always-on front door to the Academy

It runs every week from ads aimed at skin professionals, pays for itself at the front, and sends the practitioners who are ready into the discovery call you already use. Your client ladder stays exactly as it is.

Meet Faye

Hi, I’m Faye Knox

I’m a Functional Acne Practitioner and educator, with a skin clinic in Brampton, Chesterfield and clients online around the world. My 16-week Acne Programme takes a 360 approach: skin, hormones, gut, nutrition and lifestyle, guided by functional blood work.

I founded the Functional Skin Academy to teach skin professionals the same eight-pillar framework, through a six-month, CPD-accredited qualification.

Questions

Before you book your seat

Who is this for?

Skin therapists, facialists, aestheticians and other skin professionals who work with acne clients.

What if I can’t make it live?

Every seat includes the replay, so you can watch it when it suits you.

Is this medical training?

No. It’s an educational class about a functional, whole-person approach. It is not medical advice and doesn’t replace a GP or other medical professional.

Why only £17?

Because seeing how I teach should be an easy first step. Come, take what helps, and decide afterwards whether the Academy is right for you.
